project.description:
The plan model, as data: what a plan is - its objectives, its decisions, its acceptance, and its phases with their tasks, metrics and dependencies. Pure values: no ES modules, no server, no viewer, no wire format. A plan never decides how it is shown.
The packages are the ones the model has always had, so every plan written against them compiles and runs unchanged.
Depends on nothing but the ontology markers - so the compiler, not a convention, keeps it pure.
